title: Rollplex: Cross-Phase GPU Spatial Sharing for Vision Language Model Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.14498v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable embodied agents to reason and act from visual observations and language instructions. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training enhances these capabilities using task feedback, but current on-policy RL runtimes execute rollout, reference scoring, and actor training in strict serial phases. While effective for text-only RL, this phase-granular execution is wasteful for VLMs, where processing dense video inputs and prompt prefixes occupies a large fraction of each phase. Because prefix processing is independent of the generated response, it can be run alongside rollout decoding, which leaves GPU compute capacity underutilized, without breaking synchronous on-policy semantics.   We present Rollplex, a runtime that decomposes the reference and training phase and moves the prefix computation into the rollout decode window. Realizing this schedule requires more than concurrent kernel launches: naive colocat

translated_title: Rollplex：面向视觉语言模型后训练的跨阶段GPU空间共享
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）使具身智能体能够根据视觉观察和语言指令进行推理和行动。强化学习（RL）后训练利用任务反馈增强这些能力，但当前的同策略RL运行时在严格的串行阶段中执行回放、参考评分和演员训练。虽然这种方法对纯文本RL有效，但对VLMs而言，这种阶段粒度的执行是浪费的，因为处理密集视频输入和提示前缀占据了每个阶段的大部分时间。由于前缀处理独立于生成的响应，它可以与回放解码并行运行，这会使GPU计算能力利用不足，同时不破坏同步同策略语义。我们提出了Rollplex，一个将参考和训练阶段分解并将前缀计算移入回放解码窗口的运行时。实现这种调度需要超越并发内核启动：简单的共存...
tldr: Rollplex通过将VLM后训练中的前缀计算与回放解码并行化，打破传统串行阶段限制，提升GPU利用率且不破坏同步同策略语义。
en_tdlr: Rollplex parallelizes prefix computation with rollout decoding in VLM post-training, breaking serial phase constraints to improve GPU utilization while preserving synchronous on-policy semantics.
